art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Veigar is an adult yordle mage with a shadowed face and two yellow eye lights beneath an enormous pointed blue-purple hat. His full robe, mittens, boots, belt, and gold-trimmed staff preserve the compact species silhouette, with the staff’s recognizable angular head and no visible teeth or threatening facial distortion.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: blue, plum, gold, lilac pencil shadow, pale starlight; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
